title.narrative: Strengthening UNESCO-EU partnership for better response on CLT in emergencies

description.narrative: In the context of the UNESCO's partnership with the European Union (EU) Institutions in the field of culture, this activity aims at supporting the policy dialogue between UNESCO, the EU and its Member States for strengthen strategies and programming on the protection of culture in situations of emergencies. Key EU fora and entities for this dialogue are the Council of the EU and its Presidencies during the biennium 2024 and 2025 (Belgium, Hungary, Poland and Denmark), the European Parliament, the European External Action Service (including the EU Delegations) and the relevant European Commission Directorates Generals. Outreach, visibility, and advocacy activities will be organized in the context of these fora, and their discussions on culture in emergencies, including in the follow up of the Strategy on the EU International Cultural Relations.
